name: SAFI Lead Intake & Gated Follow-Up (R-MKT-01, R-MKT-02)

nodes.name: Lead Intake Webhook
nodes.notes: Bound strictly to 127.0.0.1/local network and protected via native n8n Header Auth credential (X-SAFI-Webhook-Secret); zero $env access (R-SEC-02, R-SEC-03).

assignments.name: preparedFollowup
assignments.value: ={{ 'Hello ' + ($json.body.leadName || 'Customer') + ', thank you for contacting us regarding: ' + ($json.body.inquiryText || 'your inquiry') + '. Here are available consultation times.' }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ingested', executionId: $execution.id, conversationId: $json.conversationId, subjectLineDisplay: $json.subjectLineDisplay, recipientEmail: $json.recipientEmail, preparedFollowup: $json.preparedFollowup, followupIdempotencyKey: $json.followupIdempotencyKey }) }}

nodes.name: Return Verified Intake Status to Gate
nodes.notes: Responds before triggering outbound gate submission to avoid per-conversation dispatch lock re-entrancy.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ conversationId: $json.conversationId, subjectLineDisplay: $json.subjectLineDisplay, engine: 'n8n', operation: 'dispatch_followup', idempotencyKey: $json.followupIdempotencyKey, recipients: [$json.recipientEmail], correlationId: $json.correlationId || undefined, payload: { conversationId: $json.conversationId, recipientEmail: $json.recipientEmail, messageBody: $json.preparedFollowup }, actor: { actorGuid: 'proxy-n8n-workflow', actorKind: 'PROXY', meetingContext: Object.assign({ proxySource: 'n8n-lead-intake', proxyExecutionId: $execution.id }, ($json.originActor && $json.originActor.meetingContext) ? $json.originActor.meetingContext : {}), portContext: Object.assign({ proxyPort: 'n8n-internal' }, ($json.originActor && $json.originActor.portContext) ? $json.originActor.portContext : {}), permissionProvenance: Object.assign({ proxyRole: 'WORKFLOW_PROXY', delegatedBy: ($json.originActor && $json.originActor.actorGuid) ? $json.originActor.actorGuid : '' }, ($json.originActor && $json.originActor.permissionProvenance) ? $json.originActor.permissionProvenance : {}) } }) }}

nodes.name: Submit Controlled Effect to Gate Adapter (NO Direct Send)
nodes.notes: R-GATE-01: Never use direct SMTP/email/SMS nodes in n8n. Authenticates via native n8n Header Auth credential (X-SAFI-Gate-Secret) and preserves proxy provenance.

main.node: Return Verified Intake Status to Gate
